algorithms.name: MBE (Multiplier Bootstrap-based Exploration) for MAB, Gaussian weights N(1, sigma_omega^2) with pseudo-rewards 0 and 1

conditions: arm 1 is the unique best arm

source.label: thm.MAB.1
source.quote: Consider a $K$-armed bandit, where the reward distribution of arm $k$ is $1$-sub-Gaussian with mean $\mu_k$. Suppose arm $1$ is the unique best arm ... Let the tuning parameters satisfy $\lambda \geq \left(1 + 4 / \sigma_{\omega} \right) + \sqrt{4 \left(1 + 4 / \sigma_{\omega} \right)/ \sigma_{\omega} }$. Then, the problem-dependent regret is upper bounded by \[ \operatorname{Reg}_T \leq \sum_{k = 2}^K \Big\{ 7 \Delta_k + \frac{10 \big[ C_1^* + C_2^* \big]}{\Delta_k} \log T \Big\}

results.notes: Regret defined via means in expectation -> pseudo-regret. Algorithm does not use T; bound holds for all T, so anytime.

bound.expression_latex: 7 K \mu_1 + C_1^*(\lambda, \sigma_{\omega}) K \log T + 2 \sqrt{ C_2^* (\lambda, \sigma_{\omega}) K T \log T}

symbols.C_1_i: C_1(sigma_1, sigma_k, lambda, sigma_omega) = 10[8 sqrt(2) max_k sigma_k^2 (log D_2/(3 log 2) + 1) + 38 sigma_omega^2]
symbols.C_2_i: C_2(sigma_1, sigma_k, lambda, sigma_omega) = 50 lambda^2 sigma_k^2 + 10[D_1 (log D_2/(3 log 2) + 1) + 38 sigma_omega^2], D_1, D_2 as defined in Theorem C.1

conditions: reward of arm k is sub-Gaussian with variance proxy sigma_k^2

source.label: thm.MAB
source.quote: Consider a $K$-armed bandit, where the reward distribution of arm $k$ is $\subG(\sigma_k^2)$ with mean $\mu_k$. Suppose $\mu_1 = \max_{k \in [K]} \ \mu_k$ ... Let the tuning parameters satisfy $\lambda \geq \left( \frac{4 \sigma_1}{\sigma_{\omega}} + 1 \right) + \sqrt{\frac{4\sigma_1}{\sigma_{\omega}} \left( \frac{4 \sigma_1}{\sigma_{\omega}} + 1\right)}$, Then the problem-dependent regret is upper bounded by \[ \operatorname{Reg}_T \leq \sum_{k = 2}^K \Delta_k \Bigg[ 7 + \left\{ C_1 + \frac{C_2}{\Delta_k^{2}} \right\} \log T \Bigg]

results.notes: General-variance version of Theorem 5.1; tuning of lambda depends on sigma_1, so learner needs knowledge of the variance proxy.

bound.expression_latex: 7 K \mu_1 + \max_{k \in [K] \setminus \{ 1 \}} C_1(\sigma_1, \sigma_k, \lambda) K \log T + 2 \sqrt{\max_{k \in [K] \setminus \{ 1 \}} C_2 (\sigma_1, \sigma_k, \lambda) K T \log T}

symbols.C_2_max: max over suboptimal k of C_2(sigma_1, sigma_k, lambda, sigma_omega)

conditions: reward of arm k is sub-Gaussian with variance proxy sigma_k^2
